name: brainy-app-ai
description: Brainy — Istiyak's personal, local-first infinite-canvas research/synthesis tool.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n tokens,server,web -c yellow,blue,green "npm run build -w packages/tokens" "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
